message:
Let me try to build the whole project with the fuzzer. Let me run autogen and configure with the fuzzer flags.

<｜｜DSML｜｜ode>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'cd /gt/_work/src && ./autogen.sh 2>&1 | tail -5 && echo "===CONFIGURE===" && CC=clang CFLAGS="-fsanitize=address -g -O1" ./configure --enable-fuzztargets 2>&1 | tail -20'</parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜ode>
